mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of Answer Engine Optimization services for contractors?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AEO services for contractors varies based on the scope of work, the size of the business, and the competitiveness of the service area. Prices can range from a few hundred dollars per month for basic optimization to several thousand for comprehensive strategies including extensive content creation, schema markup implementation, and continuous monitoring across multiple platforms. A consultation with an AEO specialist can provide a tailored quote based on your specific goals and current online presence.
